title: Trace where a protected request stops
description: Inject one request-path condition, then choose how an unavailable policy bundle is handled. The trace separates identity, authorization, and service availability.

stages.label: Client identity
stages.detail: The proxy presents a short-lived workload credential.

stages.label: Local policy gate
stages.detail: A signed policy bundle evaluates this request tuple.

stages.label: Server identity
stages.detail: The destination proves its workload identity.

stages.label: Payment handler
stages.detail: Business logic runs only after both gates pass.

failures.label: Healthy request
failures.detail: Identity, policy, and destination are available.

failures.label: Expired caller credential
failures.detail: The client workload credential is expired.

failures.label: Explicit policy denial
failures.detail: The caller is authenticated but this action is not allowed.

failures.label: Policy bundle unavailable
failures.detail: The local proxy cannot obtain a usable current policy bundle.

failures.label: Destination unavailable
failures.detail: The payment handler is down after authorization succeeds.

fallbacks.label: Fail closed
fallbacks.detail: Reject requests whenever no usable policy decision exists.

fallbacks.label: Bounded last-known-good
fallbacks.detail: Use a signed cached bundle for at most 10 minutes.

fallbacks.label: Fail open
fallbacks.detail: Let authenticated traffic proceed without authorization.
